Description: Oswald and Helen Dauer have their first formal conversation in the Living room, introducing themselves and discussing personal topics such as family relationships and marital status.
Location: Living room（Living room）
Key Information:
  - Oswald and Helen Dauer meet for the first time and briefly introduce themselves.
  - Oswald mentions that he wants to go to the Chapel, but Helen Dauer advises him not to go out in this kind of weather.
  - Oswald introduces himself as the last member of the Galley family, but says he has no connection to the current head of the family.
  - Helen Dauer asks about Oswald's marital status. Oswald says he has always liked being alone, but regrets not passing on the family's bloodline.
  - Helen Dauer mentions that she has two children, though they do not always follow her arrangements.
  - Helen Dauer confirms that Mr. Dauer is not here and did not take part in this trip.
  - Oswald and Helen Dauer speak politely and express that they are pleased to meet each other.
Characters:
  [Oswald Brian Arthur Galley] Person No. 3, the last member of the Galley family.
    · Introduces himself as the last member of the Galley family.
    · Says he likes living alone and regrets not passing on the family's bloodline.
    · Mentions that he once lived in this house and discusses family matters with Helen Dauer.
  [Helen Dauer（Helen Dauer）] Person No. 9, the lady of the villa.
    · Has her first formal conversation with Oswald and asks about his marital status.
    · Mentions that she has two children and says they do not always follow her arrangements.
    · Mentions that Mr. Dauer is not on this trip, though he originally wanted to come with everyone.
